name: Trio School of Music, Dance & Languages
audience: Sunnyvale families; multilingual households; adult students
description: Private school teaching music, dance and languages, founded in 2002 and run in Sunnyvale since 2011.
serviceCopy: Dance and movement for young students.
Russian, Italian and heritage language classes.
insight: Three departments under one roof — music, dance and languages — with a term calendar that families actually need to see.
usps: One building for music, movement and languages
Adult as well as youth programs
differentiators: Publishes a real course catalogue with ages, level and placement

reputation.note: 47 reviews with no equivalent first-party presence: the proof exists, it is just not published by them.

afford: Multi-instructor private school with real payroll and a six-day schedule
Tuition for music and language instruction is durable household spend
risk: Owner or volunteer admin: content must be trivially maintainable
Department breadth means information architecture work, not just design

copy.h1: One school: music at four, languages for life.

copy.lede: Trio has been the school families recommend to each other for more than twenty years: music, dance and languages under one roof in Sunnyvale, taught by the same faculty year after year.
